title: Fourier expansion on the Boolean cube
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. For each subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, define its monomial by $\chi_S(x)=\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ and its Fourier coefficient by $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_y[f(y)\chi_S(y)]$, where the expectation is uniform over the cube. Then $f(x)=\sum_{S:\,\widehat f(S)\ne0}\widehat f(S)\chi_S(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
